scope: DS-Bot AI-OS reuse audit and decision assets

reuseModes.B: SDK, official API, protocol or format

candidates.name: DeepSeek Harness
reusableMechanisms: agent loop and session event lifecycle
limitations: experimental Agent Teams has a lead/subagent identity model
candidates.finalDecision: Use as the sole Agent Runtime and documented execution substrate

candidates.name: DS-Bot
candidates.runtime: ESM Node DSH plugin, React client, Electron app
reusableMechanisms: Bot roster and Main Bot rights
limitations: message path has multiple persistence write sites
control center is fragmented across settings/pages
candidates.finalDecision: Keep as the sole product and organization authority

candidates.name: Hermes Agent
candidates.runtime: Python 3.14, uv, desktop/Node and Rust components
candidates.finalDecision: Reference design only; no runtime import or copied code

candidates.name: Hermes Bot Mode
candidates.runtime: JavaScript plugin for Hermes desktop gateway
candidates.finalDecision: Do not integrate; DS-Bot already owns equivalent product behavior

candidates.name: OpenMausBot
limitations: would duplicate rooms, Bot access and approval
candidates.finalDecision: Conformance reference; only a small pure helper may be extracted after a failing DS-Bot test

candidates.name: Agent Memory Repo
limitations: no scoped permissions, BM25, journal, snapshots or undo
repository contains no implementation engine or tests
candidates.finalDecision: Keep the adopted format; DS-Bot implementation remains authoritative

candidates.name: OpenCode
limitations: GitHub /latest metadata returned v1.19.5 while the release feed contained v2.3.0
candidates.finalDecision: Reference design only; DSH remains the runner

candidates.name: Pi
limitations: alternative Session format and agent loop

candidates.name: Obelisk
candidates.finalDecision: Do not copy or link; keep DS-Bot chat-index implementation

candidates.name: OpenViking
candidates.runtime: Python >=3.10 server, Rust crates, FastAPI, vector backends, optional Redis/MySQL; TS SDK Node >=18; DSH plugin Node ^22.19 || >=24
reusableMechanisms: persistent pending capture queue with single-flight drain
limitations: vector backend outside current memory design
DSH plugin peer packages target an older DSH version and require a compatibility spike
server and SDK/plugin have different licenses; only the Apache-2.0 plugin/SDK may cross the product boundary
candidates.finalDecision: Do not add by default; consume the Apache-2.0 DSH plugin/SDK against an external server only after DSH compatibility, AGPL-boundary and measured-gap review

candidates.name: Temporal
candidates.runtime: Go 1.27.3 server, persistence/visibility stores, workers, task queues and cluster deployment
candidates.finalDecision: Conditional TaskRuntime backend only after a measured local recovery failure

candidates.name: LangGraph
limitations: would be a second Agent Runtime
candidates.finalDecision: Do not integrate; use checkpoint/interrupt invariants for TaskRuntime tests

candidates.name: LiteLLM
candidates.license: MIT outside litellm/enterprise/; enterprise tree is separately licensed and requires commercial authorization
limitations: DSH already owns provider routing/retry/token metering
candidates.reuseMode: D; C for cost data/calculator only
candidates.finalDecision: Do not integrate router/proxy; a user-deployed LiteLLM may be an external OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and USD cost support uses price data plus a thin adapter only

candidates.name: Model Context Protocol
limitations: do not vendor a second registry
DS-Bot loopback server hand-writes the 2025-03-26 initialize protocol while the official SDK supports the 2026-07-28 modern era
DSH and DS-Bot currently carry different MCP client package versions
candidates.finalDecision: Use DSH mcp-client for outbound servers; replace the hand-written loopback server with the official server SDK and unify package versions

candidates.name: OpenTelemetry JavaScript
candidates.inspectedVersion: v3.1.1 upstream; current DSH app lock uses 2.11.0/0.222.0/API 1.9.1
candidates.runtime: Node/browser SDK, providers and OTLP exporters
limitations: dsh-otel is not in current app dependency set
OTel 3.1.1/0.301.1/API 1.10 requires coordinated DSH upgrade and Node >=22.15
candidates.finalDecision: Do not add a direct SDK or global provider; use DSH ctx.otel and coordinate any upgrade through DSH

features.title: Chief Agent
features.existingDsBot: Main Bot rights, group admin and group goals; no dedicated Chief product object
features.existingDsh: agent loop and orchestration primitives
features.dependencies: Existing Main Bot and group-goal services
features.compatibility: No new identity or runtime required
features.finalDecision: Present Chief as a product role over Main Bot + goals; do not add another runtime
features.migration: Add role projection and prompts only after existing Main Bot behavior is frozen
features.acceptance: A Main Bot can receive a goal, organize members, supervise execution and return verifiable completion evidence

features.title: Bot lifecycle management
features.existingDsBot: roster.js, store.js, agents.js, turns.js and create/delete/duplicate actions
features.existingDsh: Session persistence, agent lifecycle and scoped tools
features.finalDecision: Keep DS-Bot lifecycle; no external roster import
features.acceptance: Existing roster/delete/restart tests remain green

features.title: Bot identity and roles
features.existingDsBot: Main Bot list, instructions, character, model, workspace, group admin and capability attachment
features.existingDsh: Execution Session identity and model selection
features.finalDecision: Keep current identity model; DSH owns only execution identity
features.acceptance: Roles and authorization tests pass across restart and model switch

features.title: Multi-Agent organization
features.existingDsBot: Main Bots, members, groups, sections, local-agent Bots and team board
features.existingDsh: Subagents and experimental Agent Teams
features.integrationCost: None for current; M for optional DAG
features.compatibility: DSH Agent Teams has a different lead/subagent identity model
features.finalDecision: Keep DS-Bot organization; extend task graph only after a failing test
features.acceptance: A dynamic team can be assembled and its members remain independently addressable after restart

features.title: Bot-to-Bot communication
features.existingDsBot: delivery.js, ledger.js, inbox.js, backlog.js and request/response envelopes
features.existingDsh: agent.send, steer, followup, Session inbox and events
features.integrationCost: None now; M for envelope split
features.compatibility: Current send funnel is the only product authority
features.finalDecision: Keep delivery; apply the architecture blueprint's envelope/queue/waker split before new modes
features.acceptance: Messages survive restart, coalesce correctly and never silently disappear

features.title: Group chat and message routing
features.existingDsBot: groups.js rounds, mentions, relays, room logs, admin and group sessions
features.existingDsh: Session primitives and message delivery
features.compatibility: External room schemas are similar but incompatible
features.finalDecision: Keep DS-Bot rooms; use external behavior as conformance cases
features.acceptance: Mention, relay, admin, pause, timeout and recovery tests pass

features.title: Agent dispatch and scheduling
features.existingDsBot: turns.js, delivery.js, groups.js and steer.js
features.existingDsh: Agent loop, step lifecycle, concurrency and cancellation
features.compatibility: No second loop can be introduced
features.finalDecision: Keep DSH dispatch; no runtime adapter
features.acceptance: A user, Bot, group and scheduled trigger all run through the same turn path

features.title: Task planning
features.existingDsBot: Group goals with stages, acceptance, constraints and assigned tasks
features.existingDsh: Plan/todo services and experimental shared task DAG
features.dependencies: Existing goals, handoffs and task ledger
features.compatibility: Stage-based goals are not an arbitrary dependency graph
features.finalDecision: Extend the existing goal model with dependencies/parallel branches only when required
features.migration: Versioned goal schema migration with archived goals read-only
features.acceptance: A goal with dependencies, one parallel branch and a blocked task is visible and executable without a second task store

features.title: Long-running task management
features.existingDsBot: Group idle driver, handoffs, schedules, resume journal and task ledger
features.existingDsh: Process-local jobs, schedule and non-resumable workflow
features.dependencies: DS-Bot persistent task records + DSH execution primitives
features.compatibility: Temporal would add a cluster; DSH jobs are not durable
features.finalDecision: Keep local task path; define TaskRuntime seam; Temporal only after measured failure
features.migration: Introduce TaskRuntime view before new storage; add backend adapter behind feature flag if needed
features.acceptance: A task can be observed, paused, restarted and completed exactly once with an evidence trail

features.title: Session management
features.existingDsBot: Bot parts, group own-parts, current/earlier Session switching and archive
features.existingDsh: Session format v4, persistence, projection, query and title services
features.finalDecision: Keep DSH persistence/query; DS-Bot only owns product mapping
features.acceptance: Parts, archival and cross-restart Session reads pass

features.title: Context compression
features.existingDsBot: steward.js, checkpoint/handoff summaries and memory snapshots
features.existingDsh: Compaction engine, pruning and image offload
features.finalDecision: Keep DSH compaction and Steward; no copied or parallel compressor
features.acceptance: Long turn, context pressure and checkpoint tests pass

features.title: Handoff
features.existingDsBot: Parent/child work tree, persistent result files, abandonment and restart recovery
features.existingDsh: Agent messaging and subagent result delivery
features.finalDecision: Keep DS-Bot handoff contract
features.acceptance: Long result, nested work, abandonment and restart tests pass

features.title: Checkpoint and recovery
features.existingDsBot: Session parts, inflight notes, handoff result files and ledger books
features.existingDsh: Session replay; workflow has no journal/resume
features.dependencies: DSH session event log + DS-Bot recovery records
features.finalDecision: Use Session replay as the checkpoint base; add idempotency keys only after a reproduced duplicate
features.migration: Define checkpoint fields alongside TaskRuntime view
features.acceptance: Recovery from kill/restart leaves no duplicate external side effect and no lost pending message

features.title: Task recovery after restart
features.existingDsBot: resume.js, handoff recovery tests and durable task ledger
features.existingDsh: Session log replay; process-local jobs die with the process
features.dependencies: Existing DS-Bot durable files + DSH sessions
features.compatibility: Local recovery exists but generic long-task recovery is incomplete
features.finalDecision: Fix local gaps first; Temporal is conditional
features.migration: Add a restart acceptance suite before any cluster
features.acceptance: A multi-step task resumes after process kill with exact status, owner and next action

features.title: Long-term memory
features.existingDsBot: Bot/group/team Markdown memory, journal, snapshots, summaries and archive
features.existingDsh: Context injection points; no competing product memory store
features.integrationCost: None now; L for optional OpenViking adapter
features.compatibility: Current format is already adopted and tested
features.finalDecision: Keep local Markdown as source of truth; OpenViking is optional external adapter
features.migration: No migration; adapter preserves scopes, ids, expiry, pin and undo semantics
features.acceptance: Memory survives restart and every reader sees the same scoped fact

features.title: Memory retrieval
features.existingDsBot: BM25 ranking, auto-recall, recall tool, scope filters and prompt budget
features.existingDsh: Context/session references and compaction
features.finalDecision: Keep local BM25; evaluate OpenViking tiers only on measured retrieval failure
features.acceptance: Relevant facts are recalled under budget, with no cross-scope leak

features.title: Memory correction
features.existingDsBot: Append-only journal, retired.jsonl, batch undo, move/restore/forget, pin and expiry
features.existingDsh: Session history only
features.compatibility: Current semantics already exceed candidate runtime
features.finalDecision: Keep journal and undo; do not replace with vector metadata
features.acceptance: Every mutation has a reversible evidence row and stale/expired facts disappear

features.title: Skills
features.existingDsBot: Shared capability library, skill/pack attachment and learning proposals
features.existingDsh: Skill registry, discovery, catalog and tools
features.finalDecision: Keep DSH skill registry and DS-Bot packs
features.acceptance: Skill discovery, attachment, approval and next-turn activation pass

features.title: MCP
features.existingDsBot: capabilities.js and local-agent adapter use DSH MCP plus official client 2.4.0; local-agents/mcp.js still hand-writes a 2025-03-26 loopback server
features.existingDsh: MCP client, resources, transports and tool registration
features.dependencies: DSH MCP + official MCP server/client SDK; one coordinated package version
features.finalDecision: Use DSH mcp-client for outbound servers; replace the hand-written loopback server with the official server SDK and keep only the token/onCall adapter
features.migration: Introduce official server transport behind the existing LoopbackMcp interface, then remove hand-written JSON-RPC
features.acceptance: MCP server tools/resources pass conformance and permission tests

features.title: Tool invocation
features.existingDsBot: Scoped team tools, hidden-tool mask and per-Bot capability attachment
features.existingDsh: Tool registry, hooks, execution modes and step tool sets
features.finalDecision: Keep DSH tool registry as the only path
features.acceptance: Every visible tool is registered, scoped, authorized and audited

features.title: Browser automation
features.existingDsBot: Bot-owned browser sessions, tasks, refs and script runner
features.existingDsh: browser-use package and tools
features.finalDecision: Keep Bot-owned browser lease and consent
features.acceptance: Separate Bots cannot interfere and browser actions remain auditable

features.title: Computer operation
features.existingDsBot: Computer leases, Mac helper, app grants, approvals and live indicators
features.existingDsh: computer-use, sandbox and native adapters
features.finalDecision: Keep current consent/lease model
features.acceptance: Foreground/background control, stop and app grant tests pass

features.title: Filesystem and workspace
features.existingDsBot: Bot/group folders, scoped files, preview and save
features.existingDsh: Workspace, filesystem, shell, sandbox and spill
features.finalDecision: Reuse DSH sandbox/filesystem; DS-Bot owns selection only
features.acceptance: Traversal, scope, attachment and cross-platform file tests pass

features.title: Scheduled tasks
features.existingDsBot: Schedules page, owner validation and Bot/group delivery
features.existingDsh: Schedule service, recurrence, catch-up and historical Session changes
features.finalDecision: Use DSH schedule service and DS-Bot UI/ownership
features.acceptance: Recurring, one-shot, catch-up, timeout and restart tests pass

features.title: Email, calendar and external connectors
features.existingDsBot: Mail/IM/phone connectors and MCP connector catalog; no unified calendar model
features.existingDsh: MCP/resources and connector runtime
features.dependencies: MCP servers + OAuth/key boundaries + DSH tools
features.compatibility: Do not create a fourth inbox or scheduler
features.finalDecision: Add calendar only behind the existing connector/event boundary
features.migration: Normalize external events into one typed model while retaining source ids
features.acceptance: Connection, consent, retry, disconnect and scoped delivery tests pass

features.title: Model provider and DeepSeek runtime
features.existingDsBot: Per-Bot model, provider/key settings, model refresh and usage display
features.existingDsh: llm providers, DeepSeek/pi-ai adapters, retry and token meter
features.reuseMode: D; C for cost data only; external endpoint configuration only
features.integrationCost: None now; S for external gateway
features.dependencies: DSH provider registry; optional LiteLLM endpoint
features.finalDecision: Keep DSH as the sole model router; LiteLLM is only a user-deployed OpenAI-compatible endpoint. USD cost uses price data plus a thin adapter.
features.acceptance: DeepSeek primary, fallback, rate-limit, cost and per-Bot model tests pass

features.title: Model upgrade and compatibility
features.existingDsBot: DSH pin, update flow, model refresh and provider tests
features.existingDsh: Provider packages and exact release compatibility
features.compatibility: Upstream rc.3 is not yet the pinned baseline
features.finalDecision: Separate compatibility branch and release gate; no local model catalog fork
features.migration: Upgrade DSH pin with migration notes and rollback pin
features.acceptance: A real Bot turn, tool call, MCP call and fallback pass on the new pin

features.title: Permissions, approval and sandbox
features.existingDsBot: Bot/group permissions, approval cards and privacy/secret checks
features.existingDsh: Approval service, permission presets and sandbox policy
features.integrationCost: None now; M for governance audit
features.compatibility: Do not create a second policy engine
features.finalDecision: Route every action through DSH approval/preset; add append-only product audit view
features.migration: No migration; add audit event mapping
features.acceptance: High-risk action is blocked without approval and appears in the audit trail

features.title: Logging, metrics and traces
features.existingDsBot: usage.sqlite, diagnostics, turn metrics, chat/task ledgers
features.existingDsh: Session telemetry and ctx.otel seam; current coordinated OTel 2.11.0/0.222.0/API 1.9.1 line
features.dependencies: DSH dsh-otel + coordinated OTel package line; no standalone NodeSDK
features.compatibility: Current app does not mount dsh-otel by default
features.finalDecision: Keep local-first; optional OTel export through ctx.otel only
features.migration: Mount service in opt-in profile; keep local logs unchanged
features.acceptance: Exported trace/metric/log has consent, redaction, bounded queue, coordinated version and shutdown proof

features.title: Control Center
features.existingDsBot: Existing React shell, settings pages, team board, command palette and live activity
features.existingDsh: UI slots, settings shell, client primitives and host services
features.compatibility: No external admin template is compatible
features.finalDecision: Extend existing shell into Dashboard/Chat/Organization/Tasks; no second navigation
features.migration: Add read-only pages first, then mutations through existing teamActions
features.acceptance: Dashboard, Chat, Organization and Tasks render real data with loading/empty/error states and pass responsive visual checks

features.title: Information Hub
features.existingDsBot: Connectors, IM, mail, activity feed and Bot inbox
features.existingDsh: MCP/web/browser and Session events
features.finalDecision: Create one typed external-event model over connectors; no new scheduler or memory inbox
features.migration: Backfill existing connector rows by source id
features.acceptance: A mail/IM/web event reaches the inbox, is classified, linked to a task and can trigger an approved action

features.title: Evolution Engine
features.existingDsBot: learning.js, goal skills and learning cards
features.existingDsh: Skill registry and evaluation infrastructure
features.dependencies: Learning, task runtime and reuse registry
features.finalDecision: Extend learning into a measured capability-gap -> research -> test -> integrate loop
features.migration: Reuse registry is the durable decision memory
features.acceptance: A repeated gap produces a tested skill or adapter with rollback and measured improvement

features.title: Execution Nodes
features.existingDsBot: Desktop/web, local-agent CLIs, workspaces and phone relay
features.existingDsh: SSH, workspace, subprocess and schedule remote-host primitives
features.dependencies: DSH SSH/workspace primitives and current desktop bridge
features.finalDecision: Use DSH primitives before designing a node protocol; no microservice split for appearance
features.migration: Define node identity/health/lease only after local remote execution proves insufficient
features.acceptance: A task can run on a remote workstation and return status/results after disconnect

define a single TaskRuntime read model over goals, handoffs, task ledger, board archive and resume records
add a read-only Control Center projection before mutations
evaluate the pinned DSH upgrade in an isolated compatibility branch
